Protein
Forms organic matrix, for collagen, production of hormones, growth factors
Minerals
Boron: Considered to have minor role in bone function
Calcium: Main bone-forming mineral; 99% in skeleton
Copper: Functions in lysyl oxidase, an enzyme essential for cross-linking 
of collagen fibrils
Fluoride: Can replace hydroxyl groups in hydroxyapatite to form less 
soluble fluoroapatite
Iron: Cofactor in enzyme involved in collagen bone matrix synthesis, 
cofactor in 25-hydroxycholecalciferol hydroxylase
